Name: Ilyeana's Bearcrows for Alternative Textures (Scarecrows)
Author: IlyeanaPlus
Description:
[b]Having problems with those pesky crows pecking out your crops? Have no fear, these adorable Bearcrows* have you covered![/b]

Using [b]Alternative Textures[/b], you will be able to easily change the form of the default (craftable) scarecrows to become fierce defenders. Use them anywhere on the farm to protect your crops, to decorate the valley, or simply because they are fun critter pals!

If you like this pack, have suggestions for more scarecrows, or simply want to say "HI!" feel free to leave a comment. I love hearing from the lovely Stardew Valley Community <3


*I know they are not technically ALL in the bear family. But hey ho creative license!


[u]I use my favourite mods in screenshots! They include:[/u]
Gwen's Paths
DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour

Thank you for downloading and supporting my artistic endeavours. Please ask permission before using any of the assets included in this pack however!
